text.inkscape:label: panel 2 caption
text.tspan: Terra smiled when she felt the cold

text.inkscape:label: panel 3 caption
text.tspan: Luna pressed the knife into Terra’s skin
Luna’s warm breath came close again.
Terra squirmed against the ropes a little.
“Kill me.” She scrunched her face to wiggle

text.inkscape:label: panel 4 caption
text.tspan: The knife’s point dragged gently, gently
At last, Luna said “Why should I?”
Luna said “I do. I like seeing you all needy too.”

text.inkscape:label: panel 5 caption
text.tspan: Terra mewed. “We’ve done a bunch of slow
teasing plays lately, and I don’t think I can take
another one today. Please, Mistress, please,

text.inkscape:label: panel 6 caption
text.tspan: The knife tickled the nape of Terra’s neck
— then vanished. Luna laughed at her whimpers.
out of your misery already. Poor baby.”

text.inkscape:label: panel 7 caption
text.tspan: Cold sharp plunged into Terra’s breast,
hot wet poured down her belly and up her neck.
Agony seized her, took her whole body and mind,
the whole stream of consciousness. She gasped,
then tried to gasp, but couldn’t.

text.inkscape:label: panel 8 caption
text.tspan: And then Terra glowed, golden joy
literally shining around the knife in her heart,
tickling her scalp and her toes.
She cooed and sobbed and laughed,
the sweat on her face, her whole face sparkling.
The ropes fell slack and slithered away.
The knife shrank and slipped out and tinkled
on the floor. The wound in her breast closed,
And the blindfold lifted. Terra lay still.
Then opened her eyes so she could

text.inkscape:label: panel 9 caption
text.tspan: Luna was breathing hard, thrilled, at once slaked
and the music of their feelings resonated

text.inkscape:label: design notes
text.tspan: * Stick with CSS classes to set basic text styles.
* Text outlines via _dotted_ stroke seems odd,
but the workaround smooths and rounds out
odd angular areas that would otherwise form.
* Use manual line breaks, like poetry;
looks better at this size than text just
auto reflowing anywhere in a sentence.

cc:Work.dc:title: Sapphic Sacrament Sacrilege
cc:Work.dc:description: A short story about magical sapphic kink, and repurposing Christian themes for instead describing the transcendent experience of doing an extreme trust exercise with your partner.
